test_title: PYST 35: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Identify the sentence that contains no spelling errors.

options.text: Manisha got overwhelmed by the tremendus offer by a company to work in collaboration with internet personel.
Manisha got overwhelmed by the tremendous offer by a company to work in collaboration with internet personnel.
Manisha got overwellmed by the tremendous offer by a company to work in collaborasion with internet personnel.
Manisha got overwhelmed by the tremendous offer by a company to work in collaborasion with internet personnal.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Manisha got overwhelmed by the tremendous offer by a company to work in collaboration with internet personnel."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• All the words in sentence 2 are spelled correctly. "**Tremendous" **means very great in amount, scale, or intensity; **"personnel" **refers to the people employed in an organization.
 
• The term **"internet personnel" **correctly describes individuals who work within the digital/online sector of a company.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sentence 1 contains** "tremendus," **which is a misspelling of **"tremendous."**
 
• Sentence 3 includes** "collaborasion,"** which should be spelled as **"collaboration."**
 
• Sentence 4 uses **"personnal,"** which is a misspelling of **"personnel."**
